best_stable_new_config.note: Highest utilization among new stable configs, fewer processes = less overhead

memory_ceiling.note: 40 GiB RSS from 48 GiB RAM — only 8 GiB headroom, page file essential

crash_boundary.note: 16 workers per CP-SAT process triggers stack buffer overrun — hard limit

private_bytes_plateau.note: All matrix configs cluster around 48-50 GiB private bytes regardless of worker count — suggests a virtual memory commit ceiling per CP-SAT

reasoning: 2x12: best CPU utilization (53.2%) among new configs, fewer processes = less IPC overhead
3x8: moderate utilization (41.5%) but 3 processes gives more candidate parallelism
4x8 baseline (built-in defaults) still wins on raw utilization (68.1%) — investigate why
Avoid 1x16 — crashes. Avoid 4x8 with env override — RSS too high
All configs near 50 GiB private bytes — page file critical for stability
next_steps: Run longer (1h) comparison of 2x12 vs 3x8 vs baseline to measure candidate throughput
